changelog_text:
### Added

- Standalone Oxidizer on macOS: `oxidizer-macos` finds the [macOS port](https://github.com/renancamm/ksa-macos-port)'s app in `~/Applications` (or `/Applications`) and restarts itself with the environment the port's launcher sets up (its .NET runtime, GLFW/KTX shims and Metal hooks), so it runs with no setup. Tested on an M3 Pro.

listing.name: Oxidizer (StarMap mod)
listing.abstract: Oxidizer as a StarMap mod: runs Kitten Space Agency mods written in Rust or as Rhai scripts, next to StarMap's C# mods.
listing.description:
Oxidizer lets you write Kitten Space Agency mods in Rust or as Rhai scripts, so no C# is needed. This is Oxidizer as a StarMap mod: StarMap starts the game and loads it like any C# mod, and Oxidizer then runs the Rhai and Rust mods, side by side with StarMap's C# mods.

![The two example mods, one in Rhai and one in Rust, drawing ImGui windows in game](ksa-image:example-mods)

Mods can run code every frame, draw ImGui windows, read and change game objects, patch game methods and change their results, use hotkeys, keep settings, and add entries to a Mods menu in the game's menu bar. Rhai scripts need no compiling and reload while the game runs; Rust mods use the `oxidizer_api` crate from crates.io, with typed bindings for the game generated by `oxidizer --bindgen`.

Mods for Oxidizer are listed with StarMap as their loader and this mod as a required dependency, so a mod manager installs everything they need.

It runs on Windows, Linux and macOS. On a Mac it works with the [macOS port](https://github.com/renancamm/ksa-macos-port) of the game and the StarMap it installs (Apple Silicon).

Prefer no StarMap? The standalone loader is listed as `Oxidizer`, and the same mods run with it too.
